title: ISO 3534-1:2006 Statistics vocabulary and symbols Part 1
bounded_claim: Defines general statistical terms and terms used in probability; current edition remains published while a revision is under development.
authority_limit: Probability/statistical terminology does not define measurement uncertainty, physical quantity semantics, study acceptance or business decisions.
negative_twin: probability distribution != measurement uncertainty != decision confidence

title: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook probability distributions
bounded_claim: Defines and operationalizes probability distributions as foundational statistical objects and distinguishes model assumptions from empirical adequacy checks.
authority_limit: Statistical distribution model does not establish physical measurement uncertainty or domain truth without an explicit model and evidence.
negative_twin: distributional model != observed frequency != physical truth

title: JCGM GUM suite and 2026 publications
bounded_claim: JCGM owns measurement-uncertainty guidance, including GUM, Monte Carlo propagation supplements, conformity assessment and 2026 amendments/examples.
authority_limit: Measurement uncertainty consumes probability/statistical concepts but does not own general probability semantics or non-measurement uncertainty.
